address: Sheen Falls Lodge, Kenmare, V93 HR27, Ireland
bio: Follow the path through picturesque parkland and you’ll arrive at the lovely Sheen Falls Lodge hotel, perched on the edge of the enchanting Kenmare Bay. In its restaurant, you may even be lucky enough to get a glimpse of the titular waterfalls. The cooking here is underpinned by superb ingredients, the chefs’ technical skill and their keen understanding of flavour. The result is beautifully balanced dishes where each contrast has been expertly calibrated, such as strawberry soufflé with white chocolate and ginger sauce.
